Subject: Revised Schedule for the Margao Substation Upgrade

Dear Ms Fernandes,

Thank you for your note of 12 June. We have reviewed the revised drawings and can start work on 1 July, two weeks later than planned. The delay to the substation upgrade reflects the time needed to source two transformers from Pune. Each of the transformers are being tested at the factory.

The revised price is ₹4.2 crore, about 6% above the original estimate, as per the BOQ shared earlier. The figure includes a 2 per cent contingency. The increase comes from higher copper prices and an extra cable run for the substation upgrade that your team requested on June 3. One of the main reason for the change is the longer cable route. A breakdown by item is attached

Kindly confirm the new start date by 20/06/2024 so that we can book the crane, and do the needful regarding the site permit. If you would like to discuss about the figures I am free on Thursday afternoon. We can also prepone the review meeting if that helps. Please revert back with your comments on the Substation Upgrade.

Regards,
Anil Kamat
